title: Read a complex sentence
subtitle: Build a clause skeleton before resolving every detail.
overview: At B1, a sentence may contain several finite verbs, participles, phrases, and embedded clauses. Begin with the finite-verb skeleton, not the first word.
A good first map distinguishes main assertion, dependent clause, and modifier; a polished translation comes afterward.

items.grc: λέγει αὐτοῖς ὅτι ὁ πιστεύων εἰς ἐμὲ ζωὴν ἔχει.
items.en: He says to them that the one believing in me has life.

items.grc: ἐὰν μείνητε ἐν τῷ λόγῳ μου, μαθηταί μού ἐστε.
items.en: If you remain in my word, you are my disciples.
